meta.promptText: Indian winters mein dry skin ke liye konsa moisturizer kharidna chahiye?

response.text:
Indian winters mein **dry skin ke liye cream-based, fragrance-free moisturizer** kharidein—gel nahi. Ingredients list mein **ceramides, glycerin, hyaluronic acid, shea butter ya panthenol** dekhein; ye skin barrier ko support karke moisture lock karte hain.[2][4]

**Achhe options:**
- **CeraVe Moisturising Cream** — bahut dry ya flaky skin ke liye  
- **Cetaphil DAM / Moisturising Cream** — dry aur sensitive skin ke liye  
- **Bioderma Atoderm Creme** — tightness aur roughness ke liye  
- **Venusia Max Cream** — budget-friendly rich cream  
- **Re’equil Ceramide & Hyaluronic Acid Moisturiser** — barrier repair ke liye  

**Kaise lagayein:** Face wash ke turant baad, skin halki damp ho tab moisturizer lagayein; subah aur raat dono. Bahut zyada dryness ho to raat mein dry patches par moisturizer ke upar petroleum jelly ki patli layer laga sakte hain.[4][9]

Agar acne-prone skin hai, to label par **“non-comedogenic”** dekhein; jalan, redness ya persistent itching ho to dermatologist se consult karein.
